title: Attainment of the optimum
statement: Let $D$ be a finite nonempty label set, $V$ a finite variable set, and consider a constraint satisfaction instance on $V$ with a nonempty multiset of constraints in which every variable occurs. There is an assignment of labels in $D$ to the variables whose fraction of satisfied constraints equals the instance's optimum value.
hypotheses_covered: Every declared variable occurs in some constraint scope
